label: agent channels • proactive publish binding policy matrix
query: deterministic policy pin — no model involved
notes: Proactive publishing pins over the real AgentChannelPublishService with an isolated in-memory ledger and a fake sender: no binding means no publish capability and no prompt payload; external and channel-triggered runs are always denied; an autonomous scheduled run sends only to its own binding; a repeated intent_key yields exactly one provider write; draft and unattended-confirm modes never silently send; an ambiguous provider failure parks as delivery_unknown and a replayed key never resends; an approval whose binding was repointed since queuing is refused with binding_route_changed; agent_channel_publish stays in the external-surface deny family; zero-config derived destinations are confirm-only, surface in the prompt, queue unattended sends for approval, refuse a queued approval with binding_removed once the room leaves the write allowlist, and are suppressed by a stored customization. CI-safe: no network, no model, no keychain.
